g.text: Synthetic regression y = sin(1.3x) + 0.25x with noise s.d. rising from 0.08 to 0.50. Five numpy MLPs (1-64-64-2, tanh) trained on 600 points with the Gaussian
negative log-likelihood; conformal quantiles from 400 calibration points; coverage measured on 4 000 in-range and 2 000 out-of-range test points.
